title: meshes.json
description: One record per unique mesh. Its data is meshes/<id>.bin: each attribute in turn as little-endian float32 for every vertex (position and normal 3 each, a UV set 2), then every submesh's triangle indices in turn as little-endian uint32, winding already converted (ADR 0011).

id.description: The SHA-256 of the mesh file, cut to 32 hex digits.

name.description: The game's mesh name where it was first seen.

index_counts.description: Each submesh's number of indices, three per triangle.
